name: ani-canada-moose
prompt: A calm cartoon moose wearing a red knitted scarf stands on one side of a wide negotiating table, facing a bald eagle in a dark suit on the other side. Between them sits a stack of shipping crates. Neither character is angry; they simply hold their ground while the crates slowly pile higher between them
desc: 빨간 목도리 무스와 정장 독수리가 협상 테이블을 사이에 두고 마주 선다 — 미·캐나다 무역

name: ani-calendar-four
prompt: Four large paper calendar pages hang on a line and flip over one after another, left to right, each landing with a soft settle. The last page flips to reveal the same blank sheet as the first, as if four days changed nothing and everything at once
desc: 달력 넉 장이 왼쪽부터 차례로 넘어간다 — 나흘의 경과

name: ani-factory-line
prompt: A side view of a car assembly line. Simplified car bodies glide steadily along a conveyor from left to right while robotic arms lower toward them in slow rhythm. The line never stops and no people are visible
desc: 자동차 차체가 컨베이어를 따라 흐르고 로봇팔이 내려온다 — 자동차 생산라인
